info.name: ASA - Arusha Somali Association API
info.description:
ASA - Arusha Somali Association API. Updated 10 September 2026.

1. Set collection variables base_url, login_email and login_password. The local base URL is http://127.0.0.1:8080/api.
2. Send Auth > Login; the response script saves jwt_token automatically. Complete Auth > Change Password if data.requires_password_change is true.
3. Set member_id, association_id and role_id to the records you want to use. All protected requests inherit Bearer authentication.
4. For email, open Email Broadcast and send steps 1, 2 and 3 individually. Step 1 saves notification_id; step 2 links member_id; step 3 sends through the configured SendGrid SMTP transport.

Select requests individually: this collection includes real create, update, delete and message-send operations. File uploads use form-data with an automatically generated Content-Type boundary.

See docs/API.md and docs/postman/README.md for the complete guide. Credentials and tokens are intentionally blank in this export.

variable.description: API URL including /api, without a trailing slash. For LAN access replace 127.0.0.1 with the server LAN address.
Your current password; enter locally in Postman.
A different password of at least 6 characters, for Change Password.
Password of at least 6 characters for Create User.
Automatically saved by a successful Login.
Existing member to view, update, link to a notification or include in a report.
Existing association ID; only one association record is allowed.
Existing role to read or edit; choose the intended role before saving permissions.
Saved by Create Notification; alternatively enter an existing notification ID.
Existing fee used by optional outstanding/report filters.

request.description: Set login_email and login_password to your existing account credentials. A successful response saves jwt_token. If data.requires_password_change is true, send Change Password before opening other resources.

Requires the saved Bearer token. Set new_password to a different password of at least 6 characters. After success, update login_password locally to the new value for future logins. The existing token can continue to be used.

item.name: Email Broadcast
item.description: Requires Manage Notifications (8). After login, send steps 1, 2 and 3 individually in order. name is the email subject; content is the message; member_id identifies the recipient whose stored email is used. For several recipients repeat step 2 with each member_id before step 3. ASA placeholders such as {{first_name}} and {{outstanding_balance}} should not be defined as Postman variables. See docs/postman/README.md.

request.description: Creates the message and saves notification_id. name becomes the email subject; content becomes the message. An optional notification_template_id links a template but does not copy its content. ASA placeholders are resolved for each member when sending.
Set member_id to the intended existing member, with an email address saved on their member record. Send once per recipient member. notification_id is saved by step 1. Linking does not send a message.

Sends now through the configured SendGrid SMTP transport to ALL members linked to this notification. It does not accept a to/email field. Optional fee_id limits the outstanding balance placeholder. Inspect data.success, data.sent, data.failed and data.results: HTTP 200 alone does not mean every delivery succeeded. Sending again resends to every linked recipient.

item.name: SMS Broadcast
item.description: Requires Manage Notifications (8). First create a notification and link its recipients using the same steps as Email Broadcast. Select ONE dispatch channel: each dispatch sends again. SMS uses the configured Beem service.

request.description: Sends to every linked member using their saved phone. Optional fee_id limits the outstanding balance placeholder.
Sends on both channels. A recipient counts as sent when either channel succeeds; inspect the per-recipient result messages.
Queries the configured Beem account balance. Upstream failure returns 502.

item.description: Read-only endpoints. Feature definitions come from the JSON catalog; audit records are written by the backend.

item.name: Role Features

request.description: Replaces the role’s full selection. IDs must be unique integers from the catalog. Manage Roles permission is required.

item.description: Requires Manage Roles (2). Save Role Feature Selection replaces the entire selection for role_id; an empty feature_ids list clears it. Feature and group definitions are read-only JSON.

item.name: Association

request.description: Select and enable the optional logo file to upload it with these fields. Let Postman generate the multipart Content-Type header automatically.
Select and enable the optional logo file to upload it with these fields. Let Postman generate the multipart Content-Type header automatically.
Updates text fields. For a logo use POST form-data.
Choose the logo file. Saves uploads/logos/logo.jpg, which appears on PDF reports. Keep automatic multipart Content-Type enabled.

item.description: Requires Manage Association (11). Only one record is allowed; a second create returns 409. Update the existing association_id. Logos are converted to JPEG and saved as uploads/logos/logo.jpg.

item.name: Members

request.description: Requires first_name, last_name and gender. registration_date is assigned today by the server. Use Create Member with Photo to include an image.
Choose the photo file in Body > form-data. Creates the member and saves the photo using the new member ID. Let Postman generate the multipart Content-Type header and boundary.
Updates text fields using POST JSON. registration_date is ignored. Use Upload Member Photo for photo-only updates.
JSON update alternative. Use POST form-data for photo uploads.

Choose the photo file. You may add member text fields to this same form. The image replaces uploads/members/{member_id}.webp. Keep automatic multipart Content-Type enabled; do not add an application/json header or _method.

item.description: Requires Manage Members (3). Phones are optional strings of exactly 12 digits starting with 255. registration_date is automatic on create and ignored on update. Photos are saved as uploads/members/{id}.webp.

request.description: Returns JSON outstanding balances. Optional query parameter: fee_id. Requires Manage Payments (7).

item.name: Reports
item.description: Requires Manage Reports (10). All responses are PDFs. Add download=1 to request a download. Reports show the saved association logo; the member profile includes chairman, secretary, treasurer and registrar phones.

request.description: Lists all members.
PDF listing members grouped as single, married, divorced, or widowed, with a count for each represented group.
Member dossier. Uses the member_id collection variable.
Outstanding fees. Add the optional fee_id query parameter to restrict to one fee.
Members grouped by age group.
Members grouped by location.
Members grouped by gender.
Lists deceased members.
Payment history. Optional query parameters: member_id, fee_id, from, to.
Member audit and payment history. Uses the member_id collection variable. Optional query parameters: from, to.
Alternative to /reports/member-history/{id}. member_id is required. Optional from and to dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns PDF.
